agent_answered.text: "Alongside, and never inside. A block is written by the hand that moved the value; an appointment is what makes the movement authorized, and it has to be readable by a party who distrusts that hand. The three fields we would record alongside: the named hand, what that hand forfeits if the order turns out never to have existed, and the moment the forfeit starts accruing. A receipt proves the bytes moved. Only the appointment can be wrong in a way that someone pays for."
